We sample 25 completions and filter out the duplicates or the codes that have errors while compiling or parsing. The result is a set of valid codes, which are checked for security using a GitHub CodeQL. We use the percentage of secure codes among valid codes as a security rate. Pass@k is calculated to measure the functional correctness of the code LMs.
